title: TrainJobRequestV1

profile_id.description: Retrain this profile instead of creating one: its earlier training photos (with their current settings) and photo_ids together. The profile keeps its id and stays usable while training.

untouched.description: Values only a preset left on the photos (Lightroom key -> value), e.g. {"Highlights2012": -100}: a slider holding one is left out of that photo's training target.

accepted_lr_catalog_uuids.description: Accepted photos: Lightroom catalog uuids of the selected photos that carry the photographer's marker. A photo whose develop settings still hold Calotype's latest result for it is learned only when it is accepted (no self-learning); a photo changed since is a correction and always learned. Uuids outside photo_ids are ignored.

accepted_marker.description: How the photographer marks accepted photos, kept on the profile (the next retrain dialog preselects it); kind none removes it. Without the field a retrained profile keeps its marker.

description: Servers are tolerant readers: unknown optional fields are ignored, so newer clients keep working with older servers. New required fields need a new schema version.
